# Material Symbols

Source: https://github.com/google/material-design-icons
License: Apache-2.0, see LICENSE.

Official Material Symbols Rounded, 24px, weight 400, grade 0.
Navigation uses FILL=0 when inactive and FILL=1 when selected.
Only used assets are bundled as Android vector drawables in res/drawable/ms_*.xml.
SVG paths are unchanged; SVG viewBox origins are translated into the Android viewport.
Exact source URLs, revision and source hashes are recorded in sources.json.
